subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft instead of collapsing it to the existing summary bar?
rationale: Current Telegram scoped guidance and current code intentionally use one editable progress window and a collapse summary after the final answer; supporting full preservation adds a new public config and changes visible message lifecycle policy.

options.title: Accept a default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current summary-bar lifecycle as the default.

options.title: Keep the current summary-bar lifecycle
options.body: Leave Telegram progress mode as final answer plus compact activity digest and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

recommendation.title: Accept a default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current summary-bar lifecycle as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently carried the Telegram progress-window lifecycle and proof work that this option would extend.
